in_marathi.name: Banshi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Banshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bans’, meaning ‘to produce a sound’ or ‘melody’. In Hindu mythology, Banshi is the name of a goddess associated with music and the arts.
